Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Northwind Robotics
Location: Austin, TX
This is a fully remote role.
Employment type: Full-time

About Northwind Robotics
Northwind builds perception software for warehouse robots. Our stack includes Kubernetes and Kafka.

What you'll do
• Design and ship model training pipelines in PyTorch.
• Collaborate with hardware teams to deploy models to edge devices.
• Mentor junior engineers.

Requirements
• 5+ years of professional experience building machine learning systems.
• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
• Experience deploying models with Docker on AWS.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
• Must be authorized to work in the United States; we do not sponsor visas.

Nice to have
• Experience with ONNX or TensorRT.
• AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty certification is a plus.
• Familiarity with Terraform.

Compensation
Salary: $160,000 - $200,000 per year, plus equity.

Apply by July 31, 2026.
